faqs.question: What is Microsoft Copilot?
faqs.answer: Microsoft Copilot is an AI assistant that works within Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 to help users draft, analyze, summarize, and automate tasks.

faqs.question: Is Copilot included in my Microsoft 365 license?
faqs.answer: Copilot is available as an add-on license for eligible Microsoft 365 enterprise plans.

faqs.question: Can I customize Copilot for my industry?
faqs.answer: Yes. Copilot adapts its suggestions using Microsoft Graph and Dynamics data, providing industry-specific context.

faqs.question: Does Copilot store or reuse my business data?
faqs.answer: No. Your data stays within your Microsoft tenant. Copilot does not train on organizational or personal data.

faqs.question: Which apps support Microsoft Copilot?
faqs.answer: Copilot works across Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Dynamics 365, and more—depending on your license.
